meetdock.welcome.contents:
No meetings registered.

### 🏢 Enterprise Teams
1. **Drag & Drop .ics file**: Drag and drop an `.ics` calendar file downloaded from Teams or Outlook directly onto this pane to register automatically.
2. **Add from Clipboard**: Copy meeting invitation text and click [Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard) (`Alt+M` / `Option+M`).

> $(warning) **<font color="#d97706">Note for Enterprise Teams: .ics files downloaded from Teams do not contain recurrence information. If you want to configure recurrence, you must set up recurrence after registering the meeting.</font>**

### 👤 Personal Teams
1. **Add from Clipboard / Text**: Copy the meeting join link or invitation text and click [Add from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard) (`Alt+M` / `Option+M`) or drag & drop text into this pane.
2. **Configure Settings**: Select the title, date/time, and recurrence pattern in the dialog to register.

[Add Meeting from Clipboard](command:meetdock-solo.addFromClipboard)
